story.title: Fable 5.1 Solves the Cyphral Distich, a 370-year-old cipher

draft:
The Cyphral Distich, a 370‑year‑old cipher, finally fell to an algorithm.

Fable 5.1 combined deep language models with a specialized combinatorial search, iterating through millions of plausible word patterns until the historic text emerged. The breakthrough isn’t just a neat trivia win; it proves that modern AI can handle the kind of sparse, context‑driven puzzles that have stumped scholars for centuries.

What this means for us in software and AI is twofold: first, unsupervised models are reaching a point where they can infer structure without hand‑crafted rules; second, the same techniques could be repurposed for modern security analysis, legacy code deobfuscation, or even decoding encrypted communications in real time.

If a centuries‑old cipher can be cracked, what other entrenched problems—be they in cybersecurity, data recovery, or historical research—are waiting for a similar AI‑driven key?
